lead_raw_text:
The structure of Hf₂Si₄Ni₄ (reduced formula Hf(SiNi)₂) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 10 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Hf centers with 16 neighbors (4 Ni, 12 Si), while Ni and Si centers adopt 10- and 11-coordinate environments, respectively. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts indicate corner- and edge-sharing between Hf and Ni polyhedra, as well as between Ni and Si polyhedra, though these relations are not exclusive.
